newsitem.title: SPAIN: UNICEF raises 70.5 bln pta bond for Rwanda, Zaire.
newsitem.headline: UNICEF raises 70.5 bln pta bond for Rwanda, Zaire.

text.p: The United Nations Children Fund (UNICEF) issued 70.5 billion pesetas in perpetual zero-coupon bonds to finance projects in Rwanda and Zaire, subscribed by international and domestic financial institutions and banks.
Local press printed the official announcement on Friday.
The new bond was authorised by the Spanish stock exchange commission CNMV.
The 70.5 billion peseta bond is avaliable in 100.000 pta denominations. The bonds never expire and pay no coupons.
"With this bond, banks and financial institutions have made a donation," said a dealer in Coporacion Bancaria de Espana (Argentaria), one of the subscribers.
